query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `inventory_entries` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `entry_id` varchar(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `raw_material_id` int NOT NULL,
  `purchase_date` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `supplier_id` int,
  `supplier_name` varchar(255),
  `quantity` decimal(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  `unit` enum('ml', 'g', 'kg', 'L', 'oz', 'lb') DEFAULT 'ml' NOT NULL,
  `remaining_quantity` decimal(10, 2),
  `price` decimal(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  `currency` varchar(3) DEFAULT 'CHF' NOT NULL,
  `price_per_unit` decimal(10, 4),
  `batch_number` varchar(100),
  `expiration_date` timestamp,
  `storage_location` varchar(255),
  `storage_conditions` text,
  `notes` text,
  `quality_notes` text,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `inventory_entries_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `inventory_raw_material_idx` (`raw_material_id`),
  INDEX `inventory_supplier_idx` (`supplier_id`),
  INDEX `inventory_purchase_date_idx` (`purchase_date`)
);
